scenes.name: FLAT WORLDS
lines: On a circle, turns commute. How many dimensions does disagreement need?
圆周上的转动总是可交换的。要让次序产生分歧，至少需要几维？
A bracket that keeps a nondegenerate invariant form is orthogonal to both its inputs.
只要括号保持一个非退化不变型，它就同时与两个输入正交。
In a plane, those inputs span everything, so the bracket is orthogonal to everything: it is zero.
在平面里，两个输入已张满全空间，括号只好与一切正交：它只能是零。
A third axis makes room: there, Lean checks, a positive form locks the bracket to the cross product.
第三根轴立起来才有余地：Lean 检验，正定不变型把括号锁定为叉积的正倍数。

scenes.name: NO ROOT TWO
lines: Now integers only: a quarter turn about the first axis is one plus i, one, one, zero, zero.
现在只用整数。绕第一根轴转四分之一圈，是 1 + i，即 (1, 1, 0, 0)。
Its squared length is two; length one would need the square root of two.
它的模方是 2；要归一到长度 1，就得请出 √2。
So keep four integers and forget their scale: that leaves exactly three degrees of freedom.
那就保留四个整数、忘掉缩放：恰好剩下三个自由度。
No root for the turn either: conjugate by one plus i, divide by two, and x, y, z becomes x, minus z, y.
转动本身也不需要根号：用 1 + i 共轭作用、再除以 2，(x, y, z) 变成 (x, −z, y)。

scenes.name: ONE NAME PER RAY
lines: Each ray gets one integer name. Take minus two, two, two, two.
每条射线都有唯一的整数名字。取 (−2, 2, 2, 2)。
Divide by the greatest common divisor, two, then flip signs so the first nonzero entry is positive.
先除以最大公约数 2，再整体翻号，让第一个非零分量为正。
Its name is one, minus one, minus one, minus one. No quotient axiom: equality compares four integers.
它的名字是 (1, −1, −1, −1)。用不着商公理：判等只需比较四个整数。

scenes.name: FOUR SQUARES
lines: Squared lengths multiply: one plus i, times one plus j, has squared length two times two.
模方相乘：1 + i 乘 1 + j，模方是 2 × 2。
So a triad, a times b-bar times c, is never zero, and x, x, z returns to the ray of z.
所以三元积 a·b̄·c 永不为零，而 (x, x, z) 回到 z 的射线上。
The reading kappa is squared overlap over squared lengths: a plain fraction.
读数 κ 是内积平方除以模方之积：一个普通分数。
It never exceeds one, because the gap is a sum of six squared minors.
它永不超过 1，因为差值恰是六个子式的平方和。

scenes.name: THREE BEATS
lines: Now repeat one turn, g one-twenty, all ones, starting from one.
现在重复同一个转动 g₁₂₀ = (1, 1, 1, 1)，从 1 出发。
Beat two: raw, minus two, two, two, two; named one, minus one, minus one, minus one.
Beat three: the raw product is four, zero, zero, zero. Divide by four, and we are home.
第三拍：未约分的积是 (4, 0, 0, 0)。除以 4，回到原点。
Keep the signs, and home takes six beats: that double cover waits for chapter four.
若保留符号，就要走满六拍才回家：这层双覆叠留给第四章。

scenes.name: ORDER LEAVES A MARK
lines: Two quarter turns, about the first and second axes, in both orders.
两个四分之一圈，分别绕第一与第二根轴，按两种次序复合。
One plus i times one plus j is one, one, one, one; reversed, it is one, one, one, minus one.
Same ray? The first entries force k equals l, the last force k equals minus l, so l is zero.
同一条射线？首分量迫使 k = l，末分量迫使 k = −l，于是 l = 0。
Lean checks it in the Omega library alone: never the same ray. Order leaves a mark.
Lean 只用 Omega 库就检验了：永不共射线。次序留下了痕迹。

scenes.name: THE REAL SHADOW
lines: Classically, rational unit quaternions meet every hypothesis of the rank-five embedding, yet leave gaps.
在经典侧，有理单位四元数满足秩五嵌入的全部假设，却留着缝隙。
Add reading completeness, and Lean checks on the classical side: we get all the unit quaternions.
再加读数完备性，Lean 在经典侧检验：得到的恰是全体单位四元数。
Our integer ternions stop short: a squared reading of rank ten, each point glued to its antipode.
我们的整三元数止步于此：平方读数秩为 10，并把每个点与对径点粘合。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Math, chapter three.
《OMEGA MATH》· 第三章
